title: Step 69-D Base-price/history and Pricing Rule administration
description: Implement the HIGH-risk Admin workflows for AD-D-01 and AD-D-02 on top of canonical Step69-C: source-proven base-price history/read, informational profit-guard preview, variant-specific base-price create, Pricing Rule list/detail/create/update/activate/deactivate, explicit If-Match concurrency, fail-closed unknown-outcome/conflict/invalid handling, and Persian RTL accessible administration. Do not enter bulk pricing, FX, Excel, Backend/OpenAPI/database/Product-Design/Storefront/Current-State, Inventory/Procurement/POS, production FX provider, or Graph/Graphify scope.

dependencies.evidence: PR #372 exact artifact 1454764e94e88880df634519b14fdb222ae63dd4a4145c27acb762ee7b7c224d merged after CI/Phase A/CodeQL/Review/Lock; exact-SHA Canonical CI #2072, Phase A #1571 and CodeQL #1224 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6308184802.

evidence.intentionally_unused_operation: POST /admin/pricing/base-prices because the generated request contract has no variant_id; Admin uses the typed variant-specific create route instead of inventing out-of-contract body authority.
evidence.concurrency: Pricing Rule PATCH requires If-Match; base-price create is append-only and has no If-Match contract.
evidence.step_up: No Step-Up authority exists for Stage69-D source operations; Admin must not invent it.
evidence.retry: No Stage69-D mutation is idempotency-key protected; uncertain mutation outcomes are fail-closed and never automatically replayed.

acceptance_criteria.description: AD-D-01 reads source-proven base-price records and supports explicit variant_id history filtering without presenting collection size as global total.
Base-price preview uses POST /admin/pricing/base-prices/preview only as informational profit-guard review; it grants no apply token or permission and retains input on blocked/unavailable results.
Base-price creation uses the typed POST /admin/variants/{variant_id}/prices route with nonnegative integer Toman, valid interval/reason input and no invented generic-body variant authority.
AD-D-02 implements list/detail/create/update/activate/deactivate using only canonical pricing-rule operations; no delete route or lifecycle is invented.
Pricing Rule PATCH sends exact If-Match from server version and treats 409/precondition drift as explicit conflict requiring authoritative reread; no silent overwrite.

Stage-D mutations use the existing Admin server auth bridge, do not expose cookies/credentials to browser authority, do not invent Step-Up/Idempotency-Key, and never automatically retry an uncertain mutation outcome.

Form parsing enforces bounded Persian text/numeric/date/scope inputs; global scope is exclusive, percentage values are capped at 100, interval ordering is validated client-side as convenience while Backend remains authoritative.

Persian RTL screens expose explicit loading/empty/error/denied/conflict/invalid/unknown-outcome/success states, keyboard reachable controls, error summary focus and request-id recovery where available.
No bulk pricing, FX, Excel, Backend/OpenAPI/generated-contract/database/Storefront/Current-State/Product-Design/Inventory/Procurement/POS/production-FX-provider/Graph mutation is introduced.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, Project Owner Human Gate, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 69-D is HIGH risk. Exact-artifact Project Owner Human Gate is mandatory after technical/security/review/Lock evidence. Step 69-E remains blocked until terminal 69-D canonical closure.
